caption:
Peak wattage alone tells you little. Form factor first, a tamper for thick blends, and a multi-year motor warranty. Both AI models land on the Vitamix 5200; tight budget and frozen drinks get the Ninja BL610. 1billionmodels.com

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: Buying a blender? Don't compare peak watts
